column4: CREATE TABLE iv80_wt (id BIGINT, s TEXT)
INSERT INTO iv80_wt SELECT id, CAST(s AS INTERVAL) FROM iv80_r WHERE id = 1
INSERT INTO iv80_wt SELECT id, v FROM (SELECT id, CAST(s AS INTERVAL) AS v FROM iv80_r) q WHERE id = 2
INSERT INTO iv80_wt VALUES (100, INTERVAL '1 day')
INSERT INTO iv80_wt SELECT id, CAST(s AS INTERVAL) FROM iv80_r WHERE false
INSERT INTO iv80_wt VALUES (101, (SELECT CAST(s AS INTERVAL) FROM iv80_r WHERE id = 1))
INSERT INTO iv80_wt SELECT id, ts - ts FROM iv80_rt WHERE id = 1
UPDATE iv80_wt SET s = INTERVAL '1 day' WHERE id = 1
UPDATE iv80_wt SET s = (SELECT CAST(s AS INTERVAL) FROM iv80_r WHERE id = 2) WHERE id = 2
UPDATE iv80_wt SET s = INTERVAL '1 day' WHERE false
MERGE INTO iv80_wt t USING iv80_r r ON t.id = r.id + 1000 WHEN NOT MATCHED AND r.id = 3 THEN INSERT VALUES (r.id + 1000, CAST(r.s AS INTERVAL))
CREATE TABLE iv80_wc1 AS SELECT CAST(s AS INTERVAL) AS v FROM iv80_r
CREATE TABLE iv80_wc2 AS SELECT v FROM (SELECT CAST(s AS INTERVAL) AS v FROM iv80_r) q
CREATE TABLE iv80_wc3 AS SELECT CAST(s AS INTERVAL) AS v FROM iv80_r WITH NO DATA
CREATE TABLE iv80_wc4 AS SELECT v FROM (SELECT CAST(s AS INTERVAL) AS v FROM iv80_r) q WITH NO DATA
CREATE TABLE iv80_wc5 AS SELECT CAST(s AS INTERVAL) AS v FROM iv80_r WHERE false
CREATE TABLE iv80_wc6 AS SELECT CAST(CAST(s AS INTERVAL) AS TEXT) AS v FROM iv80_r
CREATE TABLE iv80_wc7 AS SELECT ts - ts AS v FROM iv80_rt WITH NO DATA
